Presented to the [Brighton Data Forum](https://www.meetup.com/brighton-data-forum/),
this talk walks through the evidence base behind Brighton & Hove City Council's
secondary school admissions consultation — who lives where, who goes where,
and what the proposed changes to catchment areas would (and wouldn't) do.
